integration: Intake -> Reordering: in-process reactive event port (Sinks with backpressure) carrying TelemetrySampleValidated/ValidationFailed; validation status opaque downstream
Reordering -> Ledger: in-process event port carrying TelemetryWindowOrdered/TelemetryBackfillDetected; ledger translates to Event Revisions
Ledger -> external: versioned published-language read/notification contract (TelemetryRevisionAppended)
external devices -> Intake: conformist non-blocking ingress endpoint

build_order: shared + domain (sample, boundaries, reorder window, event revision)
application ports and use cases (intake, reordering, ledger)
infrastructure adapters (reactive buffers, R2DBC append-only ledger, migrations)
api (ingress endpoint, revision published contract, error mapping)
risks: Ownership of 60s window vs append-only late-backfill revisions unclear; contexts may need to merge if atomicity is required
Behavior for samples delayed beyond 60s unspecified
Boundaries for ground contact time, respiration and swim stroke are undefined
Sustained 1Hz burst load needs bounded buffers and explicit overflow policy without dropping samples
In-process eventual consistency: failures downstream must hold/retry, not discard

persistence.storage_paradigm: Relational, append-only, time-partition friendly store (reactive access)
persistence.data_model: Event Revision records keyed by device/metric/t_device with revision number, t_ingress, validation status and raw payload; never updated or deleted; boundary definitions held as configuration
queries: Read revision history for device/metric in a time range
persistence.migration_plan: Expand-only versioned migrations; new revision tables/indexes added, none altered destructively
persistence.backup_recovery: Periodic snapshots plus WAL/point-in-time recovery; append-only nature simplifies restore
open_questions: Concrete store selection by database step
